test_policy.notes: For students entering fall 2025 or spring 2026, a standardized test score (SAT or ACT) is required only when the weighted high school GPA is below 2.80; otherwise it is optional. The page does not restate this for fall 2027. International students who graduate from a US high school must take the SAT or ACT (minimums SAT 880, ACT 18).

requirements.notes: Application fee $65 per the 2025-2026 Common Data Set (the international page gives no separate rate; fee waivers need third-party verified financial need). Minimum course requirements: 4 English, 2 social studies, 4 math, 3 science, 2 other academic units. Required: international transcript evaluation by a NACES member (except US-school transcripts), official transcripts, English proof. Essays are not required of all applicants. Common App use not confirmed on the pages read.

deadlines.label: International freshman application deadline, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: The page gives no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Applies to the application plus official test scores and transcripts. WCU makes many decisions after its Jan. 1 and Feb. 1 regular deadlines, so apply well before Feb. 1. Spring entry: Oct. 1 (all applicants). The WCU early-college page lists April 1 for international freshmen, which conflicts with the main international page.

english_policy.waiver_notes: All international students must show English proficiency unless they come from a listed English-primary country, completed the IB diploma, completed high school or higher education in an English-medium institution (the school must send a letter to WCU), or finished 24+ credit hours at a US college.

english.notes: 75 internet-based (537 paper-based). School code 5897. No 1-6 scale score is listed.

aid.notes: NC Promise sets tuition for international undergraduates at $3,500 per fall or spring semester. International students apply for WCU scholarships through the Scholarship Portal after applying; amounts are not published (scholarships@wcu.edu). From the Common Data Set: 81 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (average $6,100). WCU's pages do not describe a conditional-admission or ESL pathway for degree applicants.

cost.notes: WCU international costs page: minimum proof of funding for the I-20 is $30,304 for the first year = $10,598 tuition and fees + $13,033 living expenses + $6,355 other personal expenses (health insurance, travel). Tuition for international undergraduates is $3,500 per fall/spring semester under NC Promise. The page does not print the academic year; amounts match the CDS 2026-27 figures
